specification.selection_rule: descending exposure gap, ascending nuisance gap, ascending candidate indices
specification.disjoint_rule: no candidate reused within or between arms
specification.missing_rule: retain infeasible strata; no post-outcome threshold relaxation
specification.A1_prediction: higher a1 has later first numerical detection
specification.D_prediction: no stable residual direction is predicted; report both signs by stratum
specification.D_diagnostic_sign: higher D has earlier detection (descriptive directional diagnostic)
specification.outcome: first positive total-minus-critical numerical count at integer levels
specification.censoring: no detection up to ceiling; never replaced by ceiling+1
specification.inference: optimized finite design; descriptive, no confirmatory p-value or causal claim
